headline: DoorDash says AI agents have placed only a few hundred orders
summary: TechCrunch and Ars Technica both report DoorDash has received only a small number of orders, 'several hundred,' placed through third-party AI agents so far. TechCrunch adds DoorDash said it is open to working with agent makers, while Ars Technica frames the low volume as reflecting how early-stage the use case still is.
